reason: The lost lead stings, and an AI that follows up 24/7 is tempting, but I've never heard of FLUGIA and I'm not letting an unknown company's AI talk to my customers or sit in my CRM on a scroll. I might book the free demo, but I wouldn't pay this month.
objection: If the AI says something wrong to a customer or mishandles our data, it's my name on it. 'GDPR-compliant' is one line; I want to know where the data is hosted, who can see it, and whether this company will still exist in two years.
would_change_my_mind: A reference from a similar Belgian or French SME using it for sales follow-up, plus a setup where the AI drafts and a human approves before anything goes to a customer.
